name: capacity-100g
description: Real 100 GB-class acceptance on a POSIX bind: 100,000,000,000 bytes across 373 files of about 268 MB
notes: The workload is decimal 100,000,000,000 bytes in 373 files, the acceptance definition in profiles/README.md.
Two complete copies are required: the source LFS object and the sealed staging snapshot (about 186 GiB together).
The reserve is 210 GiB rather than 290 GiB because the measured host has about 229 GiB free; a forced rescan would need a third copy and is therefore not part of this run.
Every file stays limited to 1280 MiB and must finish complete AV and integrity checks; no sampling.
Fixtures are synthetic valid single-tensor safetensors files, not the original model weights; this run proves capacity behaviour, not model-specific detection.
